_about: The 3D people to make (scripts/assets/people3d/make-cast.mjs; docs/SPECTATOR-ART.md). Each: id, root (art/people3d: townspeople, they walk the town; art/spectators: the tournament's spectators and staff), role, height (m), from (the base person whose rig and clips are moved onto it), look (the RUN prompt: its first words must differ from every other look's, so a model is found in RUN's library after the CLI's timeout). render: how every person is rendered (the owner's choice, 2026-10-23: hands B, arms in).
